items.name: white-infinity-cove
items.text: A seamless white cyclorama studio, coved corners erasing every edge so floor and wall read as one continuous shadowless void.

items.name: dark-concrete-studio
items.text: A minimalist photo studio of power-troweled dark concrete, the sealed floor holding long soft reflections beneath raw walls marked with faint formwork seams.

items.name: light-tent
items.text: Inside a walk-in photography light tent, translucent nylon walls turning every source into wraparound shadowless glow, seams and support poles faint at the corners.

items.name: black-void
items.text: A pure black void studio, the subject floating in darkness with only controlled light defining it.

items.name: colorama-sweep
items.text: A studio with a saturated seamless colorama paper sweep curving floor into wall.

items.name: daylight-studio
items.text: A converted daylight studio, huge north-facing industrial windows and white-washed brick.

items.name: mirror-floor-stage
items.text: A studio stage with a polished black mirror floor doubling the subject in perfect reflection.

items.name: scrim-tunnel
items.text: A wrap-around scrim tunnel glowing from behind, the subject bathed in enormous soft gradient light.

items.name: concrete-wall
items.text: Before a clean, expansive cast-concrete wall, tie holes and shutter lines giving the raw surface a quiet grid.

items.name: brick-wall
items.text: Before a weathered, deep-textured brick wall, mortar lines and patina giving the backdrop quiet character.

items.name: corrugated-siding
items.text: Against rhythmic corrugated metal siding, its ribbed shadows striping the composition.

items.name: led-volume-stage
items.text: Inside a virtual-production LED volume, the wraparound emissive wall casting real interactive reflections and soft ambient spill onto the subject.

items.name: haze-gel-stage
items.text: A hazed studio stage, colored gel beams cutting visible shafts through the atmosphere against a deep charcoal backdrop.

items.name: gobo-shadow-wall
items.text: A studio wall raked by patterned gobo light, hard venetian-blind shadows slicing diagonally across the backdrop.

items.name: car-turntable-studio
items.text: An automotive studio stage, a flush floor turntable centered beneath a room-length overhead softbox that lays one unbroken highlight line, black flags rigged to swallow stray reflections.

items.name: tabletop-product-set
items.text: A tabletop product set, seamless acrylic sweep on a steel stand, mirror cards and black flags clamped to articulated arms around a single diffused key.
